newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at end of Feb.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at end of Feb.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $90.27 million in the second half of February to $6,261.37 million, according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet published on Monday.
The reserves rose $30.55 million in the first half of February to $6,140.55 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the central bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $4,280 million at end of February.
Net reserves were $4,200 million in mid-February. They stood at $4,015 at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
